logs.message: telemetry-ingestion deployment to production failed because canary health score stayed below promotion threshold; release controller halted promotion and requested rollback evidence.
logs.probable_cause: Release manifest, feature flag, or environment configuration drift.
logs.remediation_hint: Compare release manifest with deployed config, rollback canary, and rerun smoke checks.

logs.message: vector-search-gateway rejected authenticated dashboard traffic in dev; service token audience did not match the API gateway policy.
logs.probable_cause: SSO mapping, token audience, or cached authorization policy mismatch.
logs.remediation_hint: Refresh role cache, inspect IdP claim mapping, and verify service account audience.

logs.message: notification-service migration in staging did not complete; migration waited on dashboard_metrics exclusive lock.
logs.probable_cause: Schema version skew or lock contention during dashboard data migration.
logs.remediation_hint: Pause rollout, release blocking transactions, run migration dry-run, and validate schema readers.

logs.message: analytics-worker returned timeout responses in production; upstream metrics query exceeded the 15 second gateway deadline.

logs.remediation_hint: Inspect p95 traces, reduce retry concurrency, and apply query or cache mitigation.
